summary.text: Amber Neidig is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 108 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Michael Stender (R).
She works in social work care management at Geisinger and chairs the Montour County Democratic Committee, according to her Ballotpedia survey response.

paragraphs.text: Neidig said in her Ballotpedia survey that she was born and raised in Sunbury, Pennsylvania, and later moved to Danville to pursue a career in healthcare and social work.
She said she founded and leads a small nonprofit youth action group that began during her senior year at Shikellamy High School.
She said she holds certifications in graphic communications, healthcare and ServSafe food service management.
Neidig said she has chaired the Montour County Democratic Committee since 2022 and serves as the elected auditor for Mahoning Township, Danville, in a term running 2025 to 2027.
She won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary with 99.2% of the vote.
Her survey highlighted healthcare, education and infrastructure as priorities.
